text_block_list.text:
There's a huge crowd watching today's mock race.
The reason being—

Because "that" Orfevre was running.
I came to watch just to catch a glimpse of the tyrannical girl rumored to possess unquestionable power, but――

text_block_list.name: Joyfully Attending Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Lady Orfevre,
the final horseshoe inspection is complete.

text_block_list.name: Kneeling Attendant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Please change into these. I'll polish the shoes you took off.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Good work.

The notorious Orfevre
was surrounded by a massive entourage of students...

text_block_list.name: Butler-Attendant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Preparations for the race have been delayed...
Gate entry will be in five minutes.
Would you care to have a seat while you wait?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well. Let us wait here as we are.
Stunned by the bizarre sight of someone being completely waited on for every race preparation, I couldn't help staring—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —You there.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Insolent. By whose leave do you cast your gaze upon me?
Observing an exhibition race with Orfevre running is a rare opportunity. I offer an apology while explaining that was why I couldn't help watching so closely.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――……Very well.
I grant you permission to spectate. Burn the sight into your eyes.

It seems I've been permitted to watch.
Breathing a sigh of relief, I wait for the race to begin...
—The running witnessed was nothing short of tyrannical.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She broke through, she broke through, Orfevre!!
She has burst fiercely out from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaah――!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an overwhelming display of power! What an absolute league of her own!
Cruising across all alone, she reaches the goooaaal!!

Such an overwhelming run――one that could truly be called art.
Seeing that someone could run like this, I found myself learning
even as a trainer.
choice_data_list: (I need to take this as a lesson for the future...)
Talk about "unorthodox" in the truest sense of the word...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Attending Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Lady Orfevre!!
As she walked away as if her business was done, the students chased after her with joyful expressions.

If she can put on a run like that,
I can understand why anyone would
want to devote themselves to her...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A mere commoner presumes to pass judgment upon a king?

Overwhelmed by her piercing gaze, I hurried to explain myself.
To my surprise, she replied in a generous, magnanimous tone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――Very well.
Prostrate yourself and behold my supreme rule.

I stared dumbfounded as Orfevre walked away.
If it meant witnessing running of that caliber, I felt like
I'd gladly show her endless reverence.
